ak3_byte_diff.explanation: zip records each entry's modification time, so a freshly copied Image and a rewritten anykernel.sh change the archive bytes even when their content matches
ak3_byte_diff.fix: normalise the packaged entry times before archiving (implemented and verified)
ak3_byte_diff.template_entries_stable: LICENSE and the ak3 tool files keep their repository modification times because copytree preserves them

conclusion.note: choosing the signing key is a key-management decision and is not made here
options: supply a fixed CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_KEY and certificate
accept non-identical bytes and compare the Image excluding the signing material

inputs.note: scripts/build.py is a hashed local input and was edited again after these builds; each refresh moves the lock digest. sources, steps, resources, blockers and every other local_files entry are unchanged, so the kernel inputs these builds used are still the ones in the checked-in lock.

method: two full builds from one lock, same host, same sources, fresh work/out each time

packaging_normalisation.before: the same comparison previously differed by 4 bytes because zip recorded two freshly written entry times
packaging_normalisation.change: packaged entries are stamped from the locked commit date and zip runs with TZ=UTC
packaging_normalisation.verification: two packaging runs over the same Image

remaining_cause.explanation: the kernel generates a fresh random RSA module-signing key and a self-signed X.509 certificate on every build; the certificate carries the generation wall clock as notBefore and notBefore+36500 days as notAfter
remaining_cause.observed: certificate subject CN is 'Build time autogenerated kernel key'; the two builds differ only in the key material and the certificate time

ak3_sha256_before_packaging_fix.note: measured before packaging normalisation; the two archives differed by 4 bytes
